entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse monitor. This thing is garbage and I want my money back. Now.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Mark Peterson. Order number is VF-8675309. I've had it for 22 days, and I'm done with it. So just process the return.
Thank you, Mark. I have your order right here. So I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Listen, I'm not going to play twenty questions with you. It doesn't work for me, I don't like it, and I want to return it. Are you going to do this or am I going to have to speak to your supervisor and leave a review about this disaster everywhere I can?
I understand your frustration, sir. There's no need for a supervisor, I can definitely check on the return eligibility for you. Please give me just one moment to review our current policy.
Fine. But you're wasting my time.
Okay, thank you for your patience, Mark. I've just reviewed the information. According to our return policy, you are well within the 90-day window for a full refund.
Oh. It is? Well, good. Finally. So what's next? How do I get my money?

I've just approved the return in our system. I am sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file for you. All you need to do is place the VeloBand Pulse back in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it at any post office.
Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3-5 business days. You'll get an email confirmation as soon as it's processed.
Fine. Just make sure it happens. I'll be watching my account.
It will be taken care of, I assure you. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Mark. Have a good day.
